# Selected KayKit fortress source

Kay Lousberg, KayKit Dungeon Remastered 1.0, CC0 1.0.
Official repository https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0
Pinned commit b0ca9bd96a8072ab36a3a5464f00ed1e06a16d07.

Only chair.gltf.glb and the included licence were downloaded. The original
chair bytes are retained as chair.glb. intake.json records official paths,
lengths and Git blob hashes. provenance.json adds SHA256 after verification.
tools/mine_props/intake.py can repeat the pinned intake. No scripts or plug-ins
from the pack are installed or executed.

The #246 derivative is rotated to face +Z, fitted to the small throne,
recoloured and gently warped. Authored pointed backing, repaired armrests,
red cloth, raised timber platform and stone steps are added. The original
source remains intact. No other source geometry is claimed to come from KayKit.
